details: No a static rule matches and no traced-code findings identify installer-side harm in this package version. The package name suggests a fork or derivative of the Baileys WhatsApp library; that resemblance alone is not a threat class and does not drive the score. No exfiltration primitives, install-time fetch-and-execute patterns, credential-harvesting paths, silent-relay endpoints, or persistence mechanisms have been identified in the analyzed contents.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
